title: High-Power Rocketry
summary: A two-stage flight vehicle built for high-altitude experimentation and structural validation.
description: Sun Devil Rocketry researches and tests rocket propulsion concepts to help members build practical aerospace experience in design, fabrication, instrumentation, and validation.

title: Intro-Team Challenge
summary: Computational aerodynamics work focused on drag reduction and stability at flight conditions.
description: Members design, build, and fly high-power rockets with a focus on reliability, safety, and performance through iterative testing and engineering review.

title: In House Flight Computer
summary: Student-designed embedded flight computer for sensor acquisition and mission telemetry.
description: This beginner-friendly project gives new members hands-on experience in rocketry fundamentals, manufacturing, and flight preparation under mentor support.

title: Solid Propulsion
summary: An experiment and payload design program exploring onboard sensing and mission architecture.
description: The club partners with schools and community groups to teach students about rocketry, engineering, and STEM careers through demos and workshops.

title: Liquid Propulsion
summary: Research and development of liquid rocket engines for high-performance applications.
description: This project focuses on the design, testing, and optimization of liquid propellant systems for aerospace applications.
